My contribution

Fixed inventory that was missing from search because no availability records existed. Also contributed automatic quality-score updates, directory reporting and exports, billing catalog corrections, and automated journey support.

03 / CASE STUDY

A closer look: inventory availability

Updated single-resource and bulk synchronization so default-available inventory receives search-index entries. Explicit booked or unavailable dates retain priority, and batch lookups avoid repeated queries.

04 / CASE STUDY

Engineering validation

The inventory fix added 11 regression tests across vehicles, guides, and accommodation, including explicit unavailability and batching behavior. These are implementation-level checks; they do not represent a claim of completed platform-wide acceptance.
